text:
ryan: Quick sync — we're planning to unpin the default model for /v1/chat in the next maintenance window (target: 2026-04-15). Need quick alignment on client expectations, SDK behavior, and deprecation comms.

jess: +1 on timeline. main ask: what do we expect clients to do if they don't send Accept-Model? fallback to last-known default? return header advising they should pin?

ryan: Good Q. Proposal: server fallback order = 1) Accept-Model header 2) customer pin 3) org default (which will be unset after flip) 4) explicit 503 with "model_required" for strict routes. Default behavior for non-strict routes = fallback to a compatible variant for 7 days then 503.

maya: For SDKs we'll add an auto-pin grace window (30 days). SDKs will log a WARN when Accept-Model is missing and auto-insert Accept-Model using the last server-provided default for that client id. But need API to expose an advisory header like X-Model-Deprecation to surface timeline.

tom: Docs ask: can we standardize header names? propose: 
- Accept-Model: <model>@<semver-ish>
- X-Model-Deprecation: "version=2026-04-15; grace=7d; message='pin recommended'"

nina: Small concern — some customers run on Private with pinned infra. We should ensure our deprecation-only messaging doesn't trigger autoscaling or routing changes for Dedicated/Private. Maybe config flag "ignore-deprec-notice" per deployment.

ryan: Agreed. We'll gate comms by deployment type: hosted get advisory headers + email/SRE-runbook; dedicated/private only get the advisory header unless account-admin opts in. No automatic model swaps on dedicated/private.

jess: Can we add a safe example for clients? e.g. fallback pseudo-code to include in SDK/DOCS:
```
// client pseudo 
if (!hasAcceptModelHeader()) {
  if (config.autoPin && serverSentDefault()) {
    setHeader('Accept-Model', serverDefault)
  } else if (routeIsStrict()) {
    surfaceError('model_required')
  }
}
```

maya: We'll implement the SDK behavior and a WARN telemetry event "sdk.auto_pin_used" so we can track adoption. Also will surface a small UI in the console showing accounts still on default.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: maintenance window 2026-04-15T02:00Z -> 2026-04-15T04:00Z. Canary on 2026-04-14T23:00Z in us-west-2.

ryan: Action items: 1) eng-platform to land Accept-Model header and X-Model-Deprecation header (ryan). 2) SDK team to implement auto-pin + telemetry (maya). 3) Docs to add client pseudo-code + deprecation FAQ (tom). 4) CS to prepare email + support script for hosted customers (jess). 5) Eng-sre to validate canary + rollback plan (nina).

jess: One more: comms wording. We should avoid 'breaking' in the subject; use 'default model selection change — pin recommended'. I'll draft the email and drop in #announcements later.

ryan: perfect. I'll create the rollout PR and add the header spec to the API contract doc. If anyone has objections to the 30d SDK grace, speak up by EOD or I'll merge the plan. :thumbsup:
